reason: $25 to $30 for one supplement is a lot when I'm counting every dollar, and I can get magnesium at the drugstore for way less. I buy off TikTok when a creator nails a problem I have, and this ad didn't do that for me.
objection: Two capsules every day for $30 a month. For that money I can buy a whole bottle of magnesium at the store and it lasts longer.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I trust showing it actually helped her sleep, plus a price around $15 for the first box.
